# James Gartshore

> Free, plain-English tech tips on phones, computers, scams and getting online, written for people in Bridlington, Driffield and across the East Riding of Yorkshire. Written by James Gartshore, who lives in Bridlington, England, and volunteers with a local tech support group. The tips are a separate, spare-time project.

- [Get help](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/help/): free UK help lines and services by problem (scams, hands-on tech help, access needs, money, wellbeing).
- [Tech words explained](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/glossary/): plain-English meanings of common tech words.
- [About James Gartshore](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/about/): who writes the tips, and where to find hands-on help.
- [Poster design examples](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/designs/): free posters designed for local people and groups.

## [Scams and staying safe](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/topics/scams-and-staying-safe/)

Free tips to spot, block and report scams by text, phone call, email and online, plus simple ways to keep your phone and computer safe.

- [Got a text about a missed parcel?](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/fake-parcel-texts/): I wanted to share a warning about fake parcel delivery texts, as they're one of the most common scams around at the moment.
- [Ads popping up out of nowhere?](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/find-bad-app/): Following on from my post about scary pop-up adverts, here's what to do if ads keep appearing on your Android phone even when you're not using any app.
- [Scary pop-up on your phone? It's just an advert](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/scary-popup-ads/): I wanted to share a tip about those scary pop-ups that sometimes appear on phones.
- [Simple facts to keep your computer safe](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/pc-safety/): I wanted to share a few tips about keeping your computer safe, because a lot of people end up paying for antivirus they don't actually need.

## [Money](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/topics/money/)

Free tools to cut your bills, find lost pensions, check subscriptions and save money on food and everyday costs.

- [Free tools to cut your broadband and phone bills](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/cut-bills/): Today is the International Day for the Eradication of Poverty, so I wanted to share some free tools that can help you cut the cost of your broadband...
- [Save money on food with your phone](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/food-apps/): Today is World Food Day, so I wanted to share some free apps that can help you save money on food and stop good food from going to waste.

## [Getting online and staying connected](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/topics/getting-online-and-staying-connected/)

Getting started online, learning new skills for free, and staying in touch with family, friends and local communities.

- [Whatever you love, there's a community for it](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/online-communities/): I wanted to share something that a lot of people don't realise is out there.
- [What is a QR code?](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/qr/): I just wanted to share a quick tip about QR codes.

Handy tips for everyday technology, from phones and sat navs to old devices and emergency features.

- [Your phone could help in an emergency](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/phone-emergency/): Today is the International Day for Disaster Risk Reduction, so I wanted to share a few features on your phone that could really help in an emergency....
- [Is your sat nav out of date?](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/satnav/): Here's a quick tip for anyone who still uses a sat nav in the car.
- [Check your heating and hot water timers](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/heating-timers/): With colder weather approaching, now is a good time to check your heating and hot water timers.
- [Test your heating before winter](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/heating-check/): With winter approaching, now is a good time to test your heating, especially if it hasn't been used much this year.
